name: Empire State Summer B 2021
information: This is a twin competition with [Empire State Summer A 2021](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/EmpireStateSummerA2021). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Empire State Summer A 2021, your registration for this competition will be rejected. **Competitors may bring at most one guest.**
